response.overview: The Legend of Khau Vai (or Khau Vai Love Story) is inspired by the legend of the Khau Vai Love Market nestled in the rocky mountains of Hà Giang. The film tells a poignant love story between Ba, a Nùng ethnic man, and Út, a Giáy ethnic woman. Often referred to as the "Vietnamese Romeo & Juliet," their love has to overcome harsh traditional customs, class gaps, and prejudices passed down through generations. Set against majestic mountain landscapes, the two choose love despite the cruel twists of fate. More than a century later, the story of Khau Vai continues to be passed down through the highlands, becoming a beautiful symbol of sincere, loyal, and tolerant love—reminding us of the pure human bonds amidst the rocky plateau.
response.title: Chuyện Tình Khau Vai
